set.body: Introduce positive nominal AnalysisFamilyId, named family records, checked ownership registry with exact revision coverage and no duplicate/unknown/dropped owners. Keep global AnalysisRevision/RunId IDs unchanged. Provide implicit single-family resolution for all known legacy revisions/drafts; same names never define identity. Standalone codecs and JVM/JS conformance/compile-time rejection tests. Do not accept explicit multi-family StudioDocument payloads yet; reject the reserved family marker instead of silently ignoring it. Pin legacy document/science bytes and journal checkpoints. Implement shared guards against the landed data/trials schema tree.
set.title: S7.7b1 Checked family identity and legacy ownership foundation
